text: anya: Quick design review — model catalog compact-list toggle + version-lock UX. I found a few a11y nits and some behavior gaps. Posting mockups shortly :eyes: jason: 👍 compact-list is great for dense tables. main concern: version-lock discoverability. users might not notice the lock per-row when density is high.@mara thoughts? mara: Agree re discoverability. Also we should stabilize filter chip ordering — right now it reorders after refresh which is confusing when you have many facets. eli: Accessibility callout: performance badge color doesn't meet small-text contrast. I'll run the contrast check but flagging now. aria: Two placement options from design: 1) inline lock chip left of the model name, 2) a sticky selection toolbar that surfaces lock for selected row(s). Inline is more discoverable, toolbar is less noisy. anya: Mockup A = inline chip (adds a tiny 20px badge). Mockup B = toolbar with contextual lock button. Which wins for keyboard users? jason: Toolbar wins for keyboard+screenreader flows because it centralizes actions once rows are selected. But focus management must be explicit — when you select a row, focus should move to the toolbar button. mara: Also: persistence. When a user locks a model version, expectation is that the lock persists across navigation and filter changes (user intent). We should store lock in user prefs, not ephemeral UI state. eli: a11y specifics: row select should be toggleable by Space/Enter. Lock action should be addressable by a shortcut (e.g., `L`) and we should use `aria-live` to announce: "Version locked for ". Example suggestion: "Version locked: v2.1". storybook-bot: Added two stories for review: `Catalog/List/Compact+InlineLock` and `Catalog/List/Compact+ToolbarLock`. Preview: https://stb.redwood.dev/storybook/catalog-list-compact (story IDs 123,124). a11y-bot: Contrast scan results: performance badge bg #6C5CE7 on white => 3.8:1 (fails small text). Suggest #4B32D6 or increase text weight. Also recommend adding descriptive aria-labels: "aria-label=\"performance: 45ms median, 120ms p95\"". aria: UX nit: badges currently show a single number. Proposal: primary number = median latency, small p95 under it on hover or in expanded row to avoid clutter. Hover delta vs baseline as tooltip. anya: Proposal summary: move forward with toolbar-lock as default, implement persistence of locks in user prefs, update badge copy to median + p95 (tooltip for deltas), and fix color tokens for contrast. @jason can you draft keyboard/focus spec and add shortcut? jason: Will add keyboard spec + focus transitions (select -> toolbar focus) and define `L` shortcut for lock. I’ll drop a short RFC in #product by EOD. mara: I'll add a small acceptance checklist for QA (persistence, keyboard, screenreader announcements, color tokens). eli: I'll send updated color token suggestions and run another contrast pass after changes. anya: Awesome — thanks all. Filing followups: PR for behavior changes, design tweaks, a11y fixes. Will ping when drafts are ready :raised_hands:
